title: The local lint gate runs code-check and zizmor, as CI does
why: Incidents, Oct 28: batch 7 (#763) went red on code-check's ruff F541 in c166's merge/test_merge.py, and batch 6 dropped c168 on a zizmor red; in both, the lane's and the orchestrator's local `bin/ci-job gates --lint --base origin/main` had passed.
note: Debt, same class as c172. Measured by triage 10 on main 599dd58b: `ci-job gates --lint --plan` lists neither the Code check step (a `uses: ./actions/code-check` action) nor the zizmor step (`pipx run zizmor`), since --lint keeps only `python3 lint|actions/...` and bin/ste-changed lines and drops the rest silently. Next cloud lane: --lint runs actions/code-check the way it already runs ste-lint (one home: code_check.py with the --base, on changed files), and runs the zizmor step; a lint-class step it cannot run prints unknown, never nothing. Red first: today's --lint over a planted F541 and a planted zizmor finding passes. Touches bin/ci-job and its tests. Needs no answer. Port: yes, every repo that calls code-check. Placed ahead of c95 and every other cleanup step (triage 10, Oct 28; orchestrator's ask): two batches in a row lost a 50 to 60 min CI run to it. Green: PR #766 (2e442656; Opus round 1 approve, Sonnet round 2 approve), batch 8; full --lint runs Code check and zizmor (348 s). Each step unsets GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN (zizmor gave 401 with a session token). Notes: local action steps read the checkout's script and ignore if: and @ref; gates-shoot --lint reads playwright-setup as unknown. Cloud: with no pipx, --lint reads Code check unknown and a ci-job test goes red; that is c179. Done: merged in batch 8 (PR #767, main 26a539ff, Oct 28 07:42 CDT).
